newsitem.title: UK: Orders up at Siebe's control systems unit.
newsitem.headline: Orders up at Siebe's control systems unit.

text.p: British engineering and controls group Siebe Plc said on Wednesday that major project orders for its control systems division are up 25 percent year-on-year.
It said in a statement that fourth quarter bookings were strong despite continuing weakness in several market segments.
The company noted that sales of over 700 Window NT Intelligent Automation systems are helping fuel strong orders at the control systems division.
It added that there has been a "significant increase" in orders for Foxboros I/A UNIX system during the year.

"These new order levels are particularly gratifying because they are broadly based in many different market segments," said George Sarney, president and chief operating officer of the control systems division.
The group is due to unveil annual results at the end of May. It previously reported pretax profits of 331.1 million stg for the year to April 6, 1996 on turnover of 2.60 billion.
The process controls division was the star performer during that period with operating profits of 155.7 million stg on sales of 987.8 million.
